Package com.j3d.engine.react.events

Interface IdempotentEventListener<T extends EventPayload<?>,V>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of the event payload.
V - The duplicate object to check against.
All Known Implementing Classes:
GCurve, GLine, GTri
public interface IdempotentEventListener<T extends EventPayload<?>,V>
A simple interface for implementors to use such that they dont bloat some specific setting due to multiple events firing that do the same thing.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
